entries.121fa9c05f324dcc: NITTO KOHKI CO.,LTD. consists of the company, two domestic subsidiaries, six overseas subsidiaries and one other affiliate; the consolidated number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 1,032. The head office is located in Ota-ku, Tokyo.
entries.169ccdc9900232ed: This business develops, manufactures and sells blowers for septic tanks and small labor-saving pumps built into health and medical equipment. Net sales in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥4,514 million. Tochigi Nitto Kohki Co., Ltd. and NITTO KOHKI INDUSTRY (THAILAND) CO., LTD. manufacture the products; the company sells them in Japan, and the company and its sales subsidiaries in the Americas, Europe and Australia sell them overseas.

entries.2270e33960e7b406: Under Medium-Term Management Plan 2026, which covers the execution period from April 2024 to March 2027, the company has set strengthening earnings capacity and expanding investment in growth areas, optimizing the production structure and strengthening cost competitiveness, and building a management foundation for sustainable growth as its key challenges. It is investing in growth areas centered on hydrogen and new energy, optimizing its production structure and promoting DX, and is formulating Medium-Term Management Plan 2029, which it plans to announce within fiscal 2026.

entries.25283da3c3f6fbb5: It develops, manufactures and sells quick fluid couplings, which connect and disconnect industrial fluid piping with one touch; labor-saving machine tools; linear drive pumps, which are blowers for septic tanks and small pumps for incorporation into health and medical equipment; and armless door closers. entries.f929b0fdc62faffe: Under Medium-Term Management Plan 2026, which covers the execution period from April 2024 to March 2027, the company has set strengthening earnings capacity and expanding investment in growth areas, optimizing the production structure and strengthening cost competitiveness, and building a management foundation for sustainable growth as its key challenges.
